title: AI outputs are black boxes: a simple summary that opens down to verifiable data, consistent over time (2026-11-27)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
The backstage may need to be refined a little first because we made many updates without the protocols - I want to refine the protocol to test the different kinds of extraction and updating we were using.

[...] the idea that a structured governance tool built on this will probably be one of our first product offerings.

[...] The basic problem here is that Ai outputs are often black boxes, and we need to be able to be be able to both present a simple human facing summary and a way to go deeper to verify data. We also need to be able to maintain consistency over time and be able to keep using the historical data to enhance understanding and context.

sections.name: source
sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in a Claude Code session, 2026-11-27, opening the planning of the protocol / governance-product holon. Verbatim excerpts; the instructions in the same message (look up research, check transcripts, build a brief) are not recorded here.
